title: The bar in the real lab binary, not a harness
question: Same bar, rendered by the actual app through a real window: the PLANTS page was opened by a scripted mouse click and the note is a real hover. Does it hold up here?
context_md:
Taken with `xvfb-run ./target/release/lab` and the framebuffer dump hook -- so this is the real binary's own swapchain, not the contact-sheet harness. The page was opened by a synthetic left click at the button's actual coordinates and the note is the cursor resting on the TREND row. A second run (not shown) drove the speed dial to 256X by mouse alone, which the title bar and the top-left readout both confirmed.

Count: 2 scripted clicks, 1 consumed correctly before any frame had been painted (there is no layout to hit yet), 1 opened the page.
